ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: The Bazaar
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The deal is the gameplay: for a Jawa, information is loot, reading the trader is a skill, and walking away richer than you should have is the fantasy. Vanilla trade is a spreadsheet checkout; The Bazaar replaces the trade window with a searchable, sortable, column-configurable grid, intel layers gated by Social skill and found artifacts, and a whole-deal haggle duel at confirm time.
Built so far: plugin def scaffolding (columns, badges, tabs, intel layers), the RM_Window_Bazaar Dialog_Trade subclass, Mod Settings, and the read-side settlement price economy (RM_BazaarEconomy: settlements seeded from their climate, biome and adjacent liquid bodies, daily drift within x0.25-x4.0, price history and a trader-visit log), intel layers L1-L4 gated by Social, and four protocol-droid intel modules.
NOT YET SHIPPED: the WindowStack.Add Harmony intercept that actually substitutes RM_Window_Bazaar for vanilla's Dialog_Trade - so prices are still vanilla in play - plus the virtualized grid body, the haggle duel, the broker tab and banter. See `design/RimMandrake/bazaar_trade_window_design.md` for the full design and `Source/RM_Window_Bazaar.cs` for the specific hazard the intercept still owes (double TradeSession.SetupWith).
Settlement prices apply only inside The Bazaar's own window, through one postfix on Tradeable.GetPriceFor; colony wealth, raid points and market values are never touched, and trade execution is never rewritten.
